hook: If you don't describe your business, *ChatGPT will*.
dek: OpenAI just opened a Business Hub. Owners can claim a profile, fix prices and track how often ChatGPT mentions them.
title: ChatGPT Just Became a Business Directory. Claim Yours Before Someone Else Describes You.
yt_title: ChatGPT Business Hub: How Small Businesses Claim a Profile

slides.label: What's new
slides.text: On *Nov 10*, OpenAI opened a *Business Hub* inside ChatGPT. Companies can *claim their profile* and keep products and prices current.

slides.label: The data
slides.text: Owners can see how often ChatGPT *mentions* them and how many people *click through* to their site.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.text: Ask for "the best Dominican bakery in Washington Heights" and ChatGPT builds the answer from what it can find. *Now you get a say.*

slides.label: Do this week
slides.text: *Claim* your profile. Fix *hours, prices and product names*. Write it the way customers *search*.

slides.label: Stay consistent
slides.text: Match your *website* to your profile. Conflicting details are the fastest way to get *described wrong*.

cta_line: Show up first. *Tell your own story.*
